verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an official MCP server enabling AI assistants to search errors, analyze performance, and query telemetry, plus a documented web API for programmatic access to organizational data, and OTLP ingestion for traces/logs. Together these give external agents documented ways to query metrics, logs, and traces for debugging. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on report of an agent using these APIs end-to-end in production debugging, and no OpenAPI spec was found (probe returned 404s) limiting API discoverability.
